name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted social media scheduler with a Temporal workflow engine, PostgreSQL, Redis and local media storage.

alerts.message: Only the first account can sign up. Set DISABLE_REGISTRATION to false and redeploy to allow more sign-ups, including teammates you invite.
Each social network needs your own developer app. Add its keys as environment variables (for example LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID and LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET) and redeploy before connecting a channel.
